claims: Assistants were persistent API objects that bundled model choice, instructions, and tool declarations.
Threads stored messages, while Conversations store Items including messages, tool calls, tool outputs, and other data.
Runs map to Responses, and Run steps map to Items.
Responses can be used alone or with Conversation objects for stored context.
OpenAI will not provide an automated tool for migrating Threads to Conversations.
Application code owns history pruning, tool loops, and retries in the new architecture.
The guide warns that reusable Prompt objects are also deprecated.
